games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System - a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.

The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!

Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

games.name: Back to the Dawn
games.summary: In Back to the Dawn, you play a reporter caught up in a dark conspiracy and who got thrown into a maximum-security prison for not playing ball. Gather your wits and learn how to survive in this hostile environment. Explore every inch of the prison and exploit any weakness you find. Make friends (or foes) with your fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison. It's not just your life you are saving, but the entire city!

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.summary:
War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches a full-scale invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4. A young squad of South Korean soldiers fight to survive on the collapsing front lines, while half a world away a vengeful Captain Price wages a personal war from the shadows as he stays one step ahead of those hunting him. As Price’s off-book mission collides with the forces behind the invasion, the war spreads beyond anyone’s control. Modern Warfare® 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point.

- Campaign drops players into trench warfare in Korea, close-quarters combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, SAS night raids in Mumbai, and city-wide assaults to reclaim occupied territory.
- Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement.
- In DMZ, players operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every extraction run into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out.

games.name: Cotton Reboot!
games.summary:
Japan's favorite shooter mascot finally gets a worldwide release as a beautiful HD game with stunning graphics and remixed soundtracks. 

This is the original "Cute em' up", and will test your skills as well as tug on the heartstrings as Cotton and her friends are finally back in the ultimate celebration of one of Japan's most beloved gaming mascots. Choose between the HD Reboot mode or go legit with the X68000 original mode with pixel perfect graphics from the iconic Japanese home computer.

games.name: Cotton Reboot! High Tension!
games.summary:
The sequel to "Cotton Reboot!" released in 2021 is here! Will the gluttonous witch Nata de Cotton be in action again this time?

Enjoy this even more powerful and refreshing witchy shooter!

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: Gaelco Sports Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate 90s arcade rush. This collection brings back 5 legendary, lightning-fast hits developed by the arcade masters at Gaelco. Forget complex simulations; here, it’s all about raw reflexes, immediate fun, and high-speed challenges that defined a generation of cabinet gaming.

Drive at breakneck speeds in the cult-classic isometric racers World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, where every corner requires perfect drifts against a brutal 60-second timer.

Conquer treacherous slopes in Snowboard Championship, execute precise racket strikes in Squash, and dominate the sand with fierce smashes in Touch and Go.

It’s a pure dopamine rush straight from the golden age of arcades.

games.name: Moadra
games.summary: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

games.name: PEAK
games.summary: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK? Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully - every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb. The game's map rotates out every 24 hours! Try out the new layout each day, or give the same island multiple attempts in a day until you conquer it.

games.name: The Walking Trade
games.summary:
The Walking Trade is a quirky, action-packed zombie apocalypse store management game where chaos and commerce collide!

Design your shop, balancing space, aesthetics, and functionality. Organize shelves, set prices, and ensure customers leave happy - or at least alive.

Customers aren’t your only problem - zombies invade! Wield melee weapons, firearms, or whatever you can find to defend your shop during raids and hordes.

Hire survivors to scavenge supplies, serve customers, or guard the shop. Keep them equipped and motivated to reap the rewards.

games.name: Vixen 357
games.summary:
This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units. Year of 2396.

The high-mobility armored trooper "Vector," secretly developed to replace the former main weapon, "SERD."

One day, a mysterious unit attacked the base of Slash Unit, who had been training to become the pilots of Vectors. But who are they…?

Now, the battle begins again, with the secrets lie hidden!

This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units.

16 different levels of pure tactical strategy.

Features:

• Strategic Freedom: Assign any VECTOR to any character.

• Permadeath: Mistakes are permanent. Command wisely.

• Narrative Decisions: Trust no one. Learn the truth through survival.

* Gallery: view images from the original game’s illustrations, posters, box design, etc.

* Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up

* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.)

* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point

* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

games.name: Brave Dungeon + Dark Witch Story: COMBAT
games.summary:
Syega are powerful crystals that grant humans the ability to use magic. Some crystals are so powerful they have to be contained in specially prepared vessels; these are known as Magic Items. Join intrepid adventurer Al as she explores the dangerous labyrinths of Belfer Island in search of powerful Magic Items. Along the way Al will join forces with strong allies and face even stronger enemies. Can Al conquer the imposing dungeon known as Godshill and find the ultimate Magic Item?

Brave Dungeon is a dungeon crawling RPG adventure by indie games company INSIDE SYSTEM, creators of the Legend of Dark Witch series. Brave Dungeon features an easy to pick up combat system for new players. However, it also has many customization options, unique playable characters, and deep challenges for the completionist. A crafting system featuring materials dropped from enemies and treasure chests in dungeons allows you to customize your characters further. Class Changes allow the player to build their party the way they want, playing to one's own personal preferences and their characters' unique strengths.

[Dark Witch's Story:COMBAT]

Dark Witch's Story: COMBAT is a battle game where you use cards featuring characters and creatures from the Dark Witch series. The players pick 3 cards to use against each other in a best out of 3 battle. The players also gets to use Magic Items to give to their cards, which can drastically turn the tides of the battle. There are 2 different modes available, Quest mode for single-player and Battle mode for multi-player. When you play Quest mode you will win new, and stronger cards for you to use, while aiming for the title of "Game Master". [Nintendo]

games.name: Fangtopia
games.summary: Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a care-free, scare-free world of gentle chills.

games.name: Hunter's Moon
games.summary: Help Dirk, Lindsey and Miguel surf the train and collect the valuable gems. Leap from wagon to wagon gathering gems as you go, but watch out for other objects that have been discarded on top of the train. Hit them and you'll fall from the train.? Run as far as you can before you get knocked off the train? Multiple characters to unlock, including Miguel the skateboarding champ.? Beat your and other players high score? Universal game for iPhone and iPadHave you got what it takes to Surf the Train?

games.name: Dog Man: Bark in Action
games.summary:
Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!

games.name: Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Edition
games.summary:
Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in the Beans & Alpacas Expansion: Travel to Catuaí, a South America-inspired region where coffee plantations cover rolling hills, red soil shapes the land and dense greenery stretches across lower mountain slopes. New crops, animals, production chains and more than 25 new machines await.

Catuaí: Welcome to South America!

Explore a lush, humid valley with narrow roads, dusty streets, scattered rocks and a winding river running through the landscape. A small rural town with colorful buildings, shops and agricultural depots connects the region, while stilt houses line the river shore.

Coffee, Animals & New Gameplay

Cultivate coffee beans as a new crop and expand your livestock with alpacas and Brahman cows. Alpacas add new hands-on interaction through shearing and leading, while wild animals like crocodiles and parrots bring more life to the environment.

Productions, Projects & Collectibles

Create new products such as pigment and resin, and repaint houses for the community, or start production chains for crop processing. Take on the Research Center construction project, find dinosaur skeleton parts and collect your discoveries in the collectible museum.

Machines, Brands & Details

Operate 25+ new machines from Case IH, Ford, John Deere, KUHN, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, New Holland, Valtra, and many more. Colombo Industries joins the series as a new brand, while enhanced ground tool animations and improved effects increase immersion.

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary:
Thirteen months after six young girls vanished in Sicily, a new clue reopens the nightmare. 

When a mysterious recording rekindles the hope that her daughter might still be alive, Susan, against all reason, decides to go to the place where everything seems to have begun: a decaying noble residence isolated on the slopes of Mount Etna and once owned by the Ashmann family.

What starts as a desperate search soon becomes a journey into terror, where family secrets, memory, and obsession intertwine. Susan finds herself drawn into a labyrinth of relentless stalkers, hidden symbols, and supernatural phenomena. As reality fractures and dark powers rise, every step brings her closer to the truth… and to a terror older than herself.

Created to captivate both newcomers and longtime fans of the Remothered saga, Red Nun’s Legacy blends classic survival horror, stealth, and psychological horror, introducing new mechanics centered on perception, hypnosis, and environmental manipulation.

games.name: The Seance of Blake Manor
games.summary:
It is October 29th, 1897, and Private Investigator Declan Ward arrives at Blake Manor to find a missing woman.

What he finds is the Grand Séance and a group of mystics who have gathered from all corners of the world - waiting for All Hallow’s Eve, the night when the veil between worlds is thinnest. The night to tear down the barrier and speak to the dead.

Interview and interrogate your suspects, keep a record of all evidence, motivations, and clues in your journal, and confront them about their motivations when you’re certain of your deductions. Uncover the truth about Blake Manor and the mysterious séance that has brought everyone together.

Navigate Blake Manor's haunted corridors and uncover its secrets as you race against time to save Miss Deane.

games.name: Fallen City Brawl
games.summary:
As a brutal battle for control of Fallen City's criminal underworld rages, four strangers join forces to survive and reclaim the streets! With a ferocious wolf at their sides, these unlikely allies will face impossible odds. Along the way, motivations and past lives will collide, further testing their loyalty as well as their fighting skills. Only by binding together can they reach the final showdown that will decide who lives and who falls.

Inspired by arcade beat 'em ups of the late '80s and early '90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action.

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: SNO: Ultimate Freeriding
games.summary:
SNO is a game about downhill skiing where you carve your way down various mountainscapes trying to score as many points as possible by pulling off high risk maneuvers and tricks.

Go for the high score or simply flow through serene, arctic landscapes. The controls are easy to learn, and there are endless procedural mountains to explore.

games.name: SULFUR
games.summary:
Descend the depths of Sulfur in this action-adventure, combining first person shooter mechanics with role-playing elements. Make important choices to survive battles and explore a world of intense and brutal combat. 수

Plan ahead, outsmart enemies and progress a world of dark creatures and cunning evil. Utilize playful and tactile weaponry in visceral and intense combat. Create unique builds by combining weapons, gear, tools, and enchantments to suit your playstyle.Whether you’re a gun-blazing risk-taker or a careful strategist, the choice is yours. 

Adapt your approach, experiment, and survive the dangers of Sulfur.

games.name: ANOMALITH
games.summary:
Remain yourself. Live on.

Anomalies × Mutating Girl × Survival TPS

Survive a world crawling with Anomalies.
The girl faces her fate, gun in hand—

ーーーーー
■ STORY
ーーーーー
Japan, the year 20██.
Anomaly Zones suddenly appear without any sign.
In search of her friend who went missing in an Anomaly Zone, 17 year old Reona Minazuki becomes a Diver for the government-backed Anomaly Zone Countermeasures Office.

On her first Dive, as countless other Divers fall victim to the Zone, a strange power awakens within her.

The sole survivor, she heads deep into the abyss of Anomaly Zones.

Her friend's disappearance, the origin of Anomaly Zones, and the mystery of her powers—
When all of it is finally revealed, what will she see—?

games.name: Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos
games.summary: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

games.name: Hunting Simulator 3
games.summary:
This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog or fellow hunters by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

Either on foot or behind the wheel of your all-terrain vehicle, explore this open world's stunning environments.

In these ever-changing ecosystems, each animal reacts to what you do, each individual ages over time, can reproduce and exhibits true-to-life behaviour thanks to our unique “SimFauna” system.

Kit yourself out with one of the official weapons and other items, to hunt the way you want.

games.name: Metro Redux
games.summary: Survive the horrors of the Russian apocalypse - equip your gasmask and an arsenal of hand-made weaponry as you face up to the threat of deadly mutants, human foes, and the terrifying environment itself. Immerse yourself in the Moscow Metro - and witness one of the most atmospheric worlds in gaming brought to life with next-gen visuals at 60FPS.

games.name: Mouthwashing
games.summary: The five crew members of The Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching.

games.name: Phantom Blade Zero
games.summary: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.

games.name: Planted!
games.summary:
Planted! is a co-op party game that pits 1-4 players into head-to-head, horticultural combat that will require you to Sow, Grow and Throw your way to victory.  

Part harvest sim, part sports game, and 100% cultivated chaos, Planted! challenges players to take on their friends in arena combat where they will need to strategically plan their produce production for success. Will they utilise fertiliser to grow colossal crops for more points, will they steal their opponents offerings, or will they use powerups to propel themselves to victory? Only thyme will tell. 

Jump in to multiplayer (Online or offline!) chaos with friends all whilst reeking havoc across 8 diverse biomes. Multiplayer not for you? Then put your green thumbs to the test and take on the hand crafted single-player story campaign and enter the world of competitive gardening! Who knew there were so many ways to garden?!?

games.name: Souls of Bombarika
games.summary: A lone ghost battles deadly Ghost Bosses threatening humanity. Possess objects, solve reality-bending puzzles, and uncover an emotional mother-son story.

games.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT
games.summary: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Jump into an escape room set in a deranged mind and experience a first-person exploration game in a chilling new dimension. Shift between three perspectives and attempt to unravel the mystery hiding in this mind-bending psychological thriller. Project yourself into a riveting narrative experience and become immersed in an unsettling psychological thriller. Piece together a family's mystery as you recover fragmented memories from the corrupted consciousness of each perspective. In this first-person narrative mystery, you must explore the walls of the family's home to interpret events and discover the truth. Playable in VR and non-VR modes.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.summary:
Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered - the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series.

Critically acclaimed, The Wolf Among Us became one of the most celebrated story-driven adventures of its generation, praised for its unforgettable characters, sharp writing, and meaningful player choice.

Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before - honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players.

Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown, where myths and legends live secretly among us.

games.name: The Zibbo Show
games.summary:
The lights are on. The audience is going crazy. And tonight, YOU are the star of the show!

Progress through 12 rounds of increasingly dangerous opponents, build a new strategy every run, and face Zibbo himself in the in the grand finale! If you make it that far.

You and your opponent each have a 3×3 board and nine dice. Take turns placing one die at a time. Matching values in a column multiplies your score, and placing the right dice opposite an enemy column destroys their dice. Every placement is a decision full of luck, strategy, and the occasional regret. The crowd loves it either way!

Before each match, place a bet. Win and you double it. Lose and it’s gone, though honestly, losing the money is the part you’ll think about the least.

Between matches, visit the shop to collect cards, upgrade your dice, and stock up on chips. Cards trigger automatically and stack in ways you don’t always see coming. When the right pieces come together , the score explodes in ways that feel very, very good.

Every run unlocks new cards to discover and new combinations to try. With 48 cards to collect across runs, there’s always something you haven’t seen yet.

games.name: Titanium Court
games.summary:
Welcome to Titanium Court! Table for one? You have a reservation I assume? You don’t!? Ah, I see. Just minding your own business before stumbling into a realm of magic and faeries, were you? Not to worry, happens all the time. Tell you what, why don’t I see if we can squeeze you in somewhere while you become acquainted with the many amenities offered by the Court.

Amenities such as:

Puzzling Battles: For tonight's entertainment, the Court is at WAR! Just a little something to pass the time, you see. Who's in command? Why do you ask? Are you volunteering? Oh don't worry, you won't be issuing orders to these faerie troops. They wouldn't follow them anyways. I think you'll have more success commanding the terrain itself to fall in your favor, haha.

Puzzling Narrative: Lore dumps are strictly against my religion I'm afraid, so you'll have to uncover the secrets of the Court yourself. Some of them may even fundamentally change you as a person. Be careful with those!

Diverse and fulfilling career options: Warlord, Arsonist, Celebrity, Insurance Fraudster. Your time within the Court will qualify you for many of these exalted and lucrative positions.

games.name: Asylum
games.summary:
ASYLUM is an ambitious and intricate first-person horror adventure casting you into the hallucinatory setting of the Hanwell Mental Institute. Interact with its curious denizens, gather clues, unravel the mystery, and march towards a shocking conclusion.

With influences ranging from Lovecraft to Peter Cushing to Lucio Fulci, ASYLUM has been meticulously crafted with a strong focus on storytelling and atmosphere. Explore countless tenebrous environments, make your way through a towering, lifelike mental hospital, and solve compelling puzzles to find the answers you seek.

games.name: Queen's Domain
games.summary:
Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle. 

Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. 

Fight action-oriented battles with a classic stamina meter, powerful charge attacks, weapon specific special attacks, and secondary throwing weapons. Level up, accessorize, and choose from a huge catalogue of melee weapons on your quest to fight your way through the hordes of monsters and powerful bosses awaiting you in the darkest depths of the isle. 

Features:

Explore an interconnected island filled with hidden secrets

Lovingly crafted retro-fantasy aesthetic 

Action-combat with a stamina meter, special attacks, throwing weapons & more

Fly across gaps with your Holy Sword – use upgrades to fly further!

Dozens of hours of adventuring and exploration

50+ melee weapons to discover, equip, and upgrade

Use XP to level up, and eat delicious food to further increase your stats

20+ types of secondary throwing weapons allow for varied strategies in combat

Over 100 enemies, mini bosses, and bosses to defeat

games.name: SURI: The Seventh Note
games.summary: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.summary:
Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 & Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride.

Play solo or go against your friends, choosing from two trick-filled game modes. Fancy a game of chase? Then ‘Find the Cat’ will have you turning the house upside down looking for The Cat in the Hat. Or maybe you prefer getting into chaotic challenges? See how quickly you can capture penguins, decorate a cake, and who knows what else in the 18 minigames you can choose from.

But the fun doesn’t stop there, just like The Cat’s hat, it’ll be full of tricks. With varying difficulty levels, long challenges and short, there’s something for everyone.

Get ready for your house to be filled with giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: BloodRayne: Definitive Collection
games.summary:
The BloodRayne: Definitive Edition unites all three iconic entries in the series in one complete, enhanced collection, bringing the legendary dhampir back with updated visuals and modern improvements.

Become Rayne, a half-human, half-vampire agent working for the Brimstone Society, as she hunts supernatural threats across a dark and violent world. From battling occult forces tied to the Third Reich to confronting her own vampiric bloodline, Rayne’s journey spans brutal conflicts, relentless enemies, and deeply personal vendettas.

This collection includes the original BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal - Fresh Bites, combining fast-paced third-person action with stylish 2D hack-and-slash gameplay. Face hordes of soldiers, grotesque creatures, and powerful bosses using Rayne’s acrobatic combat skills, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric abilities.

games.name: HorrorVale
games.summary:
Welcome to HorrorVale! Your next door neighbors are zombies, reanimated monsters deliver the mail and ghosts hide out in your bathroom. Join Alice as she journeys through the underworld on a quest to save her zombie Dog, Scruffy from strange and unusual monsters that have suddenly invaded the once peaceful town of HorrorVale.

HorrorVale is a traditional RPG adventure game inspired by horror, full of unexpected twists and turns.

games.name: Ghost of Yotei: Echoes of Sekigahara
games.summary: Ghost of Yōtei: Echoes of Sekigahara is a new narrative expansion. Split between the present day and flashbacks to Atsu’s time on the mainland, you’ll meet Nagato, a figure from Atsu’s past who has arrived in Ezo. In the present, you’ll explore a previously unseen valley once inhabited by The Snake and his gang of loyal followers, the Vipers. In the past, you’ll experience Atsu’s time in the Battle of Sekigahara and a key moment in her life before she returned home for her quest for vengeance. You’ll meet new enemies and find new heavy weapons, new armor sets, new dyes, and more. [PlayStation]

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. 

Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

games.name: Let's Sing 2027
games.summary:
Grab the mic - or your smartphone - and get ready to shine! The karaoke game Let's Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable parties and performances.

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let's Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. 

Whether you're hosting a party or chasing your best score, it's your turn to take center stage with the ultimate karaoke game!

games.name: Pit of Goblin
games.summary:
Ever dreamed of being the lowest of the low, living a life so nasty and gnarly, even the rats look down on you? Well, in Pit of Goblin, that’s your everyday! Slap on your stinkiest boots and dive into crumbling crypts, ghastly caverns and ghost-infested ruins, every step is fraught with peril and surprises!

Your purpose is feeding the Goblin King Queen’s bottomless gut. The best part? You can drag your goblin buddies along for the misery!

Join forces with up to 3 other goblin buddies. Teamwork is key... unless, of course, you are the kind of goblin that prefers causing trouble! Will you stick together, or sneak off and get into mischief? Either way, it’s gonna be gobliny chaos.

The deeper you go, the tougher the challenge becomes. And don't forget, you have to find your way back out... if you want to live to see another day.

games.name: The Slormancer
games.summary: Fight hordes of enemies led by The Slormancer, an evil warlock from the past, in an absurd yet epic Action RPG! Featuring loads of shiny loot, tons of collectibles, countless hours of content, a frenetic gameplay and carefully crafted pixel art.

games.name: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park
games.summary:
This single-player or online co-op experience includes:
- A level 40 boost that allows you to jump right into the Echoes of Central Park campaign
- 50 stash space increase, allowing you to store more gear

EXPLORE CENTRAL PARK FOR THE FIRST TIME
Overgrown and reclaimed by nature, Central Park and the surrounding streets of Upper West Side are presented like never before. Haunted by fear and sinister tales, the park has become home to a new apex threat that lurks in its shadows. You must confront this formidable force, as well as familiar foes with their own agendas, to uncover what happened inside the park.

FIGHT ALONGSIDE UNIQUE COMPANIONS
As the Division’s mission is halted by a sinister threat, you must rely on three reluctant heroes to guide you through the park. Each brings a distinct past and fighting style, ranging from a former Division agent to a battle-hardened athlete.

UNLOCK A NEW ENDGAME EXPERIENCE
Ambushed and pressured by unknown ravagers, you first enter the park fighting to survive. Once the story is complete, the balance of power shifts, allowing you to return to Central Park and dictate the fight, pursue enemies on your own terms, and tackle new challenges to earn exclusive and valuable rewards.

EXPAND YOUR SKILLS AND GEAR
By defeating Central Park’s primary threats and their twisted abilities, you can earn new powers of your own. Six new skill variants grant beast‑like skills inspired by the horrors you’ll overcome. New gear is also introduced, including a brand-new Exotic Weapon, a new gear set, and more.

games.name: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut
games.summary:
Brilliant, burnt-out, possibly cursed – you play as operant Hershel Wilk, alias CASCADE. Five years ago you led your team into the abyss and have been haunted by your failures ever since. Now you've been recalled for a mysterious assignment that may give you a chance to prove yourself again.

Find yourself thrown into a three-way struggle for cultural and ideological power, played out across an unforgettable new city. In ZERO PARADES, the world itself is a character with its own secrets, traumas, and miracles for you to discover.

To get anywhere in this world, you'll need friends. Unfortunately, you don't have any. Instead, you'll go up against international bankers, foreign techno-fascists, psychic doppelgängers, a paranoid TV presenter, a man with a box for a heart, and dozens more. Everyone you meet has their own agendas, beliefs, and secrets for you to uncover and turn to your own ends.

games.name: Outbreak: Dead City
games.summary: Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

games.name: VOID/BREAKER
games.summary:
You are trapped in an endless sequence by the all-seeing, hostile AI. You are its prisoner - forced to fight, die, and repeat.

The machines think you'll never escape. The system is designed to keep you here.

Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through enviro destruction 

/BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK THE SEQUENCE /BREAK FREE

games.name: CRYMELIGHT
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Dark Alley
games.summary:
Kyoto, 2013. A British detective vanishes without a trace. London sends Thomas Bennett to close the case quietly. But Kyoto doesn’t do “quiet.” Beneath red lanterns and rain-slicked alleys, Bennett finds a city built on rituals, secrets... and people willing to kill to protect them.

What starts as a missing-person investigation spirals into a dangerous web involving the Dragon Vein Yakuza, a mysterious informant, and a cold institutional presence that watches every step Bennett takes. The deeper you go through nightclubs, temples, bamboo forests and mirrored corridors, the more mystery arise around the case... until the question isn’t who took Hale, but why the truth was never meant to survive.

Dark Alley is a standalone case within the Detective Bennett: Solved Cases saga, a cinematic narrative thriller with psychological tension and dry, noir humor.

games.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
games.summary:
Welcome to Escape Academy, the world’s foremost clandestine educator in the art of Escape. Whether you’re a returning student or a new pupil, you’ve come to the right place. 

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School evolves the escape room format of the first game into a whole new GENRE: This is the first open world escape room game, and it's available right in the comfort of your own home.

In Escape Academy 2, the campus is one big puzzle room. Between classes, explore a sprawling, secret-filled hub with mysterious passage ways, hidden tunnels, and dangerous traps. Or chill out with your pals and take in all the vibes that student life has to offer.

games.name: Faraway
games.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.

games.name: K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: In K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine, players immerse themselves in the demanding and fascinating world of modern music. Accompanied by their best friend Nova, they will need to commit 100 percent to the race for stardom: from intensive training sessions in the studio to the ultimate recognition on the most prestigious stages, the title offers a complete experience combining a sense of rhythm, deep customization, and community management in the era of social media.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
One night, in 1987, in the small town of Miami, Arizona, a satanic cult unwittingly summons the ancient evil, Baphomet, catapulting the town into chaos. John, awoken by the kidnapping of his neighbor, sets out into the night to fight back against the demonic invasion and rescue his friends before it's too late...

Take control of John as his adventure leads him through an hour-by-hour experience of what could be everyone's last night on Earth. As John, you will encounter unearthly evils, Demon lords, afflicted townsfolk, high school bullies, and a torrent of engaging, serial-like side stories - all nested in a larger-than-life fantasy that brings the ultimate evil to a neighborhood near you.

Choose your class, customize your abilities, and battle nightmarish creatures as you collect unique gear in order to infiltrate the massive lairs of Demon lords that have taken over the town.

games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
games.summary: - Fast pace gaming and easy to play- Wonderful graphics- Advanced multipliers mean you get the best wins possible- Auto Hold Feature: Video Poker Classic holds the cards for you! Our finely tuned auto algorithm determines your best chances at success and automatically holds your cards. You can change that of course and take a risk at grabbing the big bucksStart playing and be entertained for hours

games.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
games.summary:
To break a curse placed upon her, a young girl must venture into the haunted streets of her town at night to search for her lost memories while evading
the twisted spirits that lurk in the darkness.

games.name: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection
games.summary: Twice the fright. Traverse the haunting world of Yomawari: Night Alone as a young girl searches for her sister, then share in the terror facing schoolgirls Yui and Haru in Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive.

games.name: Citizen Sleeper: Helion Collection
games.summary:
The Helion Collection brings together the award-winning Citizen Sleeper, a gripping adventure inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, which has you living the life of an escaped worker as you attempt to survive on a lawless space station and its sequel, Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector, a dice-driven RPG where you get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.
About Citizen Sleeper
Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.
About Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Clue Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
games.summary: Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode. Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge. Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

games.name: Shrek 2 Remastered
games.summary:
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.

New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.

Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.

Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale: From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.

Swap heroes at any time: Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Fakin' It XL
games.summary:
Fakin’ It XL is all about lying your way to victory. Each round presents a simple prompt to all players on their phone or device like “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Everyone is on the same page – except for the faker, who must act as if they’ve received the same prompt as everyone else. Blend in by bluffing, grilling and deflecting through three rounds of interrogation to rack up points. Who knew that casting suspicion on others could be so personally rewarding?

Fakin’ It XL Features:

    New Hijinks-fueling Questions: Emojinal Damage and Thumb Luck mix things up alongside classic Fakin’ It question types for maximum friend-deceiving scheming:
    Emojional Damage challenges players to phrase their answers in the form of an emoji, such as “the emoji for a perfect gift for your boss” while the Faker only has a general category, like “the emoji of an object.” Now, can the Faker explain why giving their boss a shoe is a great idea.
    Thumb Luck asks everyone to weigh in with a quick thumbs up or down on three opinion-worthy items in a row, like “Working from Home” or “Dogs in Costumes”. The Faker has to choose without knowing the subject, though—can they justify their support for “Singing Along With Musicals”?
    Enhanced Remote Play: New options let your avatar take action for you, so the game works just as well on a video call as it does in your living room.
    XL-sized Parties: Now up to eight players can join the same game, making for the rowdiest Fakin’ It sessions ever. Good thing there’s plenty of new avatar choices for everyone to choose from, too.

games.name: Hazard Levels
games.summary:
The deeper the rift, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

Hazard Levels is a brand new co-op survival horror from the team behind Sker Ritual.

games.name: Sonic Pico Park
games.summary:
The latest entry in the PICO PARK series is a collaboration with SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog!

Sonic the Hedgehog, celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, joins the latest entry in the PICO PARK series, a series that has sold over 8 million copies worldwide.

PICO CAT, the iconic character of the PICO PARK series, races through the world of PICO PARK with Sonic, the world’s fastest hedgehog, and his friends, including Tails, Knuckles, and Amy.

games.name: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary:
In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem.

You’ll clear blocked paths, collect litter, fix broken signs - and occasionally drop everything to respond to urgent wildlife sightings or missing hikers. Each day brings new tasks and surprises.

Faremont’s diverse biomes range from dense forests and meadows to winding rivers. With your ranger pickup, you’ll cover long distances along the park’s road network, reaching remote areas filled with natural landmarks like waterfalls, rock formations, and scenic viewpoints.

As you explore, use your camera to observe animal behavior and expand your personal wildlife lexicon. From elusive wolves and majestic eagles to mischievous raccoons, each species adds life to the park’s biological habitat.

games.name: Dark Rail
games.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
games.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. 

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?

Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards. 

Sounds like vacation to me. 

Secure your ticket today, enjoy the dizziness later.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: With development of the next entry in the Grand Theft Auto series well underway, the Rockstar Games team is determined to once again set creative benchmarks for the series, our industry, and for all entertainment, just as the label has done with every one of their frontline releases.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online
games.summary:
For the first time ever on console, descend together. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ brings the complete game to console with full online cooperative play for up to four players. Every character, every item, every path, every ending, now with friends online.

Key Features

    Full online cooperative play for up to four players, on console.
    The complete game: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth plus all downloadable content (“Afterbirth,” “Afterbirth+,” “Repentance,” and “Repentance+”).
    Hundreds of items, dozens of characters and endlessly randomized runs.
    Rebalanced items and improvements from years of updates.

games.name: Gothic 3
games.summary: You have saved the island Khorinis from the forces of evil in "Gothic I" and "Gothic II." Now it is time to travel to the realms of the mainland. Invading Orcs have enslaved the human kingdom. There are but a few free humans in the icy north and the southern desert and a handful of rebels hiding in the forests and mountains of Midland. You may either join the rebellion or serve the Orcish Usurpers but you will ultimately tip the scales and decide the outcome of the last war to save humanity. There is no simple linear story in Gothic III – every game will be different and unique – but all will ultimately lead to you deciding the fate of Myrtana. [JoWood Productions]

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

games.name: GrimKeep
games.summary:
The city is lost. From the castle at its center an evil spreads, changing everyone into wretched parodies of life. Desolate streets infested with monsters, perpetually dark skies threaten to spread across the land.

Be the hero, reach the GrimKeep and end the source of evil; the Princess.

In a world of fairy tales turned nightmares, GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder that challenges you to master both luck and strategy. Collect powerful relics, forge unstoppable synergies, and battle through a city consumed by darkness.

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary: Download the @FreeAppADay.com Store App and wish for more top rated paid apps like Luna Bears to become FREE for a day!Collect coins, find secrets, and use amazing power-ups to save Teddy in this one touch platformer. FUN GAMEPLAY – Using one touch make Luna fly, tumble, and run. Bounce on rubber, blast from cannons, teleport with the propellobox, and discover secrets in this new take on platforming action.ENDLESS ENTERTAINMENT – Collect 180 stars and rescue Teddy while exploring unique worlds like Birthday Bash and Puzzling Puzzles.CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS - Connect with Game Center and push your skills to the limit as you compete with your friends and millions of others on the leaderboards.  Can you unlock all of the achievements?FREE UPDATES – More levels and worlds coming soon!UNIVERSAL APP – Buy it once and use it on your iPhone, iPod Touch, and iPad!  Optimized widescreen graphics for iPhone 5.Join us on the Luna Bears Facebook page: facebook.com/lunabearsgame Follow us on Twitter: twitter.com/lunabearsgame

games.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.summary:
Get ready for a cozy journey in "Hela", where you'll step into the tiny paws of a brave mouse, the beloved familiar of a witch who needs your help. 

Wander through an enchanting Scandinavian landscape filled with puzzles to solve, potions to brew, and quests to complete, all to aid your ailing witch. Whether you play alone or with friends, you're in for a treat filled with magic, companionship, and loads of charm.

"Hela" offers a delightful mix of adventure and relaxation. Enjoy exploring vast, open spaces, engaging in light-hearted play, and experiencing the simple pleasure of being a part of a caring community.

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary:
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! 

After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary:
The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples - so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination - now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

But saving a world already doomed is no easy task. With the help of Ysoris, her unlikely mentor, and Kanta, shaman prince of a lost tribe, Eline must overcome the formidable adversaries standing in her way.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

games.name: FreeStyle Football 2
games.summary:
In FreeStyle Football 2, each of the 12 characters available at launch will feature unique skills that dramatically shape playstyles, whether it’s delivering lightning-fast passes, boosting teammates’ morale, or unleashing a power shot at the perfect moment. Every match is about teamwork, precise coordination, and tactical depth, with players controlling one character each in intense five-versus-five online battles.

The game will be available in multiple editions, including Basic, Premium, Deluxe, and Limited Club Edition, with monetization through a familiar console framework of Season Passes, downloadable content, and ongoing content updates.

games.name: House Flipper 2: Pets
games.summary:
Welcome to Puffin Isle! This slightly neglected region of Pinnacove seems in urgent need of a makeover. From charming villas to forgotten landmarks, these jobs are sure to surprise you! 

Meeting friends old and new, can you help them make this place a cozy haven for all animal lovers? Or will you focus on creating your own pet-centered houses for other players to enjoy?

Learn more about different breeds and species, observe them, and fulfill their needs to see them thrive. Let one of your cats or dogs accompany you during renovations and watch your friends pet them together in the co-op mode. Relax after a day of hard work by playing with your little companions and forge a bond that will last a lifetime.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: SOMBRAS: negative frames
games.summary:
Shiomi Alterio, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, lives with her father in a quaint Japanese town after her parents’ recent divorce, far from the life in Europe she was forced to leave behind.

One night, Shiomi is engulfed by a dark dimension made of familiar streets, hungry shadows, and a cast of girls that look just like her...

Help Shiomi return home by taking pictures of unusual sights, surviving unsettling encounters, and reuniting every single fragment of her broken self.

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary:
Dive into a story-driven survival-horror adventure inspired by classics like Resident Evil and Silent Hill. 

A miracle crop designed to end famine became humanity’s ruin. It twisted people into feral creatures called Dusters, hollowed out by a chemical addiction and driven by primal hunger. 

Katherine and her daughter Ava roam the remnants of civilization, searching for a safe haven. But their journey draws the attention of the Pastor and his mysterious following. He sees remaining humans not as people, but as fertile soil for his plans.

Claw your way through decaying streets, bloodthirsty monsters, locked rooms, and forgotten corridors. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and survive encounters with feral Dusters for a chance to reach safety. Proceed with caution: every door can lead to salvation… or devastation.

Protect Ava at all costs. The world can die, but she must live. Every step draws you deeper into a hostile wilderness that wants you gone. No one is coming to save you, but you can fight. You can run. You can try to get her to safety.

games.name: Waltz and Jam
games.summary: Waltz and Jam is an action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.

games.name: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
games.summary: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game from independent studio Panache Digital Games and published by Private Division. From Creative Director Patrice Désilets, experience the beauty and danger of Africa 10 million years ago as your hominid clan must Explore, Expand, and Evolve to survive over the course of 8 million years. Write your own unique story of human evolution and see if you can survive like our ancestors before us.

games.name: Guns of Eschaton
games.summary:
The Old South is burning, but its legends are not quite (un)dead.

Guns of Eschaton is a first-person soulslike shooter set in an apocalyptic Western by legendary art director Viktor Antonov (Half-Life 2, Dishonored, Prey, Fallout 4, Wolfenstein: The New Order). It is a land of dust, blood, false saints, broken history, and occult horror - a wasteland where the road to salvation is narrow and paved with spent shells and bodies that remember your name.

You are almost ordinary: fragile, outmatched, and surrounded by a dying world full of monsters. However, you have everything you need to survive the horrors of the burning world: a Colt, the instincts of a killer, and the will to make it home, no matter how long the road becomes.
